name: agents-memory
description: Opt-in MCP transport to an explicitly configured local memory authority. No automatic authority bootstrap.

enable_mcp.title: Connect to your prepared memory authority
enable_mcp.description: Enable only after explicit DB, identity and model-route setup. Disabled by default.

config_file.title: Existing private authority config
config_file.description: Absolute path outside the plugin/cache. No config is generated.

agent_token_file.title: Existing scoped agent token file
agent_token_file.description: Absolute path to a private existing file; the token value is never stored in plugin settings.

runtime_directory.title: Verified installed runtime directory (optional)
runtime_directory.description: Exact directory containing this release bundle. Leave empty to use the plugin runtime cache.

allow_download.title: Allow pinned runtime download
allow_download.description: Download only this prerelease archive after SHA256 verification. No DB, service or credential setup.

allow_service_recovery.title: Acknowledge existing managed-service recovery
allow_service_recovery.description: The core MCP transport may recover an already-enabled receipt-owned service. It never installs one and honors an explicit stopped latch.
